# SBKJ Group

> SBKJ Group is a Chinese high-tech manufacturer of HVAC ductwork machinery, founded in 1995. It builds spiral duct forming machines, automatic rectangular duct production lines, TDF flange formers, lockformers, gore-lockers and seam closing machines. Over 5,000 SBKJ machines are installed in 80+ countries. ISO 9001:2015 and CE certified, with 60+ patents.

## Company facts

- Founded: 1995
- Headquarters: Jiangyin, Jiangsu, China
- Australia office: Box Hill North, VIC, Australia
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, CE Marking
- Patents: 60+ invention and utility patents
- Installed base: 5,000+ machines in 80+ countries
- Languages supported: English, Chinese
- Contact: sales@sbkjduct.com · WhatsApp +61 435 074 994

## Flagship machines

- **SBAL-V Auto Duct Production Line** — U-shape automatic rectangular duct line, 800–2,500 m²/day, single operator. /product/sbal-v.html
- **SBAL-III Auto Duct Production Line** — Hydraulic notching and shearing rectangular duct line, ~1,000 m²/shift. /product/sbal-iii.html
- **SBTF-1602 Spiral Tubeformer** — Spiral duct forming machine Φ80–Φ1600 mm with flying shear. /product/sbtf-1602.html
- **SBTF-1500 Spiral Tubeformer** — Spiral duct forming machine Φ80–Φ1500 mm, saw blade cutting. /product/sbtf-1500.html
- **SBEM-1250 Hydraulic Gorelocker** — Hydraulic elbow forming machine for round duct fittings, 100–1,250 mm. /product/sbem-1250.html
- **SBTDF TDF Flange Forming Machine** — Transverse duct flange roll forming, 1.5–16 mm. /product/tdf-flange.html
- **SBLC Lockformer** — Pittsburgh lock and cleat forming for rectangular duct. /product/lockformer.html
- **SBHF-I Seam Closing Machine** — Duct zipper, 15 m/min. /product/sbhf-i.html

## Product lines

1. **Spiral Duct Forming** — SBTF series tubeformers Φ80–Φ1600 mm, flying shear or saw blade cutting.
2. **Round Duct & Fittings** — Gore-lockers, elbow welders, plasma cutters, ovalizers for elbows, reducers, fittings.
3. **Auto Duct Production Lines** — SBAL-V and SBAL-III U-shape automatic rectangular duct lines.

## How to request a quotation

Email sales@sbkjduct.com or WhatsApp +61 435 074 994. Provide: duct size range, daily output target, material and thickness, country of installation. SBKJ replies with a machine configuration and budget.
